Package mcpserver; imports the standard library, `morphstudio/internal/testhelp`, `morphstudio/control`, `morphstudio/queue`, `morphstudio/github` and `morphstudio/session` only; compare with `testhelp.Equal`. The fake Control is one struct type `mmFake` of this test file implementing all 17 methods of control.Control with their exact signatures (from control/control.go) and a recorded call list (method and arguments); every other helper of this file is prefixed `mm` (other test files of package mcpserver declare their own fakes and helpers, e.g. ptFake, stFake). Never a listener: httptest.NewRequest(method, target, strings.NewReader(body)) with headers Content-Type application/json and Accept "application/json, text/event-stream" (and Authorization when the example gives one), h.ServeHTTP on httptest.NewRecorder; compare rec.Code, rec.Header().Get("Content-Type") and, for 401/404, rec.Body.String() against a Go raw string literal holding exactly the record's JSON, then + "\n"; a 200 body is decoded with encoding/json (into map[string]any or a small struct) and the named fields compared: id, result.tools[].name sorted, result.content[0].type and .text, result.isError. Write every path ("/mcp/demo", "/mcp/demo/session", "/mcp/other/session", "/mcp/nope", "/mcp"), Authorization value ("Bearer tok-1", "Bearer wrong", "Bearer id-2") and status (200, 401, 404, 405) as its whole literal; the JSON-RPC bodies are raw strings with "tools/list" or "tools/call". Go 1.25, gofmt-formatted.
